# Solar Consumer Research

> A source-verified directory of official complaint routes, residential-solar lawsuits and enforcement actions, and practical resources for consumers in all 50 U.S. states.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://solarcomplaint.com/
- Resources: https://solarcomplaint.com/resources
- Guides: https://solarcomplaint.com/guides
- Updates: https://solarcomplaint.com/updates
- Methodology: https://solarcomplaint.com/methodology
- Disclaimer: https://solarcomplaint.com/disclaimer
- State directory: https://solarcomplaint.com/resources
- State pages: https://solarcomplaint.com/states/{state-name}

## Source and citation policy

- External resources identify the publisher, source type, and last verification date.
- Government agencies and regulators are distinguished from private nonprofit organizations.
- Summaries are general public information and should not be treated as legal advice, claim evaluation, or a finding of wrongdoing.
- When citing a listed resource, prefer the linked original publisher page.

## Current coverage

- Official consumer-protection complaint routes for all 50 states
- A verified state or regional residential-solar lawsuit, settlement, investigation, or enforcement item on each state page
- Federal consumer, finance, and complaint resources
- Expanded Massachusetts consumer protection, utility, public-record, and solar-program resources
- Independent organizations, clearly labeled by role
- Source-based preparation guides on a separate Guides page

## State-page order

1. Official state consumer-protection complaint route
2. Relevant residential-solar lawsuit, settlement, investigation, or enforcement action
3. Additional state sources when available

## Accuracy notes

- Lawsuit allegations are described as allegations unless a court or settlement established an outcome.
- Lawsuits, settlements, investigations, enforcement actions, and reported private litigation are labeled separately.
- A nearby or regional case is identified as such when no suitable in-state consumer case is listed.
